about.greeting: Hi, My name is Trang Truong.
about.current_role: I am an undergraduate researcher at BullyBlocker, where I optimize LLM-based cyberbullying detection, build explainable NLP workflows, and design AI systems for safer online interactions.
about.specialization: My work focuses on machine learning, NLP, retrieval-augmented systems, multimodal AI, and practical deployment using tools like FastAPI, Docker, FAISS, Hugging Face, and cloud APIs.
about.education: I am pursuing a B.S. in Business Data Analytics at Arizona State University with a 3.72 GPA and coursework in machine learning, software engineering, system design, and social media mining.
about.competitive_programming: Recent highlights include a Bronze Medal in the 2026 NeuroGolf Championship on Kaggle, plus seven winning hackathon projects listed on Devpost, including WALL-E, EduTag, and ThreeByte.
